verification.precondition: A pure Survey initialization adapter has accepted one terminal dependency result without touching its new in-memory authoring store.
verification.stimulus: Execute tests/survey/initialization/initialization-adapter-terminal-irreversible.test.mjs with node:test and then offer a typed ready dependency result to the same adapter state.
verification.expectedSemanticState: The adapter rejects terminal-to-ready continuation with SURVEY_INITIALIZATION_TERMINAL and retains its terminal derived view.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: No coordinator or identity capability is called before or after the rejected continuation and the store remains at revision zero.
verification.forbiddenMutation: A terminal dependency state must not become recoverable or active, inspect the store, execute AT01 or T02, or append evidence to the authoring journal.

behavior: terminal dependency state rejects ready before any capability call
